coder_notes: Phase 1 first-in-human basket (advanced solid tumours; glioblastoma named in Part 2A arm label and inclusion criteria). Pembrolizumab is described as given 'as standard of care', so coded soc_backbone with M3T01 the only investigational agent. FOLFOX is split into oxaliplatin, leucovorin (folinic acid) and fluorouracil (same regimen_id). target_engagement coded unclear: pharmacodynamic data are mentioned as a basis for RP2D but no specific PD endpoint is listed; on-treatment biopsy is required but its purpose is not stated. IDH/H3K27M appear only as Part 2A exclusions (coded as eligibility; IDH-wildtype is never candidate-matched).
